name: Richmond–San Rafael Bridge
type: toll bridge; road bridge; double-decker bridge; multi-level bridge; cantilever bridge
text: The Richmond–San Rafael Bridge (officially renamed the John F. McCarthy Memorial Bridge in 1981) is the northernmost east–west crossing of California's San Francisco Bay. Carrying Interstate 580, it connects Richmond on the east shore to San Rafael on the west.

depictions.name: Richmond San Rafael Bridge
depictions.text: The Richmond San Rafael Bridge (also known simply as the San Rafael Bridge) is a World Location in Watch Dogs 2.
